rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 1.22 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

Effort at 1000 m is at or above the county median: 114 records, 81 species, 29 observation days (68th percentile; median 66). No eligible species is recorded within 1000 m and no site-bound forest NT species within 250 m, which gives LOW under the rubric.

Threatened species recorded within 1000 m are butterflies, which are not felling-relevant, and mobile birds, so they are not eligible. Examples are Polyommatus amandus (583 m) and Sturnus vulgaris (902 m, 2016).
There are 0 records inside the polygon and 0 within 250 m (county median within 250 m is 3), so near-site coverage is thin.

uncertainties: Near-site recording is thin (0 records within 250 m), so the good effort figure at 1000 m may not reflect the stand itself.
Records are mainly from 2021-2024 and may not reflect current conditions.
not_established: That the site is free of red-listed or site-bound species; absence of records is not absence of species.
Habitat quality or age of the stand.
That the site is safe to fell. LOW only orders the review queue.
next_action: Routine review. Check the stand's habitat details, as the nearby records say little about the stand itself, and re-check if new records appear before the felling start date.
